where.text: Patmos and visionary heaven and earth.

when.text: Commonly dated around AD 95 under Domitian, though an earlier date is proposed by some.

what.text: John receives visions of the risen Christ, letters to churches, cosmic judgment, the defeat of evil, and a new heaven and earth.

before.text: Concludes the New Testament with the consummation of the story.

stakes.text: Christ is victorious, evil is judged, and God dwells with his people.
